name: price-chart
title: Price chart
description: A brokerage-style price plot: one hairline stroke in the market's colour with an optional tone wash, a dotted reference rule, a price scale over faint gridlines and a time scale that re-label themselves when a drag zooms into a window, a candle view over the same geometry, a pulsing marker for a streaming quote, and a cursor that scrubs by pointer, finger, or arrow key.
